name: SOFT99corporation
summary: SOFT99corporation manufactures and sells chemical products for auto and home care in China, Taiwan, Singapore, Thailand, Malaysia, Indonesia, Vietnam, South Korea, Sri Lanka, Brunei, Myanmar, Russia, Ukraine, Germany, Poland, the United Kingdom, the United Arab Emirates, Saudi Arabia, the United States, Brazil, Paraguay, Australia, and internationally. The company offers body wax and polish, cleaners, shampoo, car wash equipment and supplies, synthetic snow tire chains, and air fresheners; and wax coatings, glass water repellants, anti-fog products, and in-car care supplies.
